listing.name: inFAMOUS 2 — infamous2-pc (ThiagoFraga761)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, videos, menus, cutscenes and gameplay from Empire City to New Marais, with controls, audio and saves. Its 54–130 FPS result covers one Ryzen 9800X3D/RX 9070 XT Linux PC. First-use shader spikes remain, and the backend is Linux-only. Portcove has not run the game. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own inFAMOUS 2 PlayStation 3 BCUS98125 version 01.00 disc tree with decrypted PS3_GAME/USRDIR/EBOOT.elf and your own PS3 dev_flash firmware. Keep generated game code local.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow scripts/setup.sh to fetch the pinned ps3recomp and title patch. Use lift.sh to translate your own PPU/SPU EBOOT, then build.sh to create work/port/build-vk. Launch with your disc through the documented work/play.sh route.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, videos, menus, cutscenes and gameplay from Empire City to New Marais, with controls, audio and saves. Its 54–130 FPS result covers one Ryzen 9800X3D/RX 9070 XT Linux PC. First-use shader spikes remain, and the backend is Linux-only. Portcove has not run the game.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
